eligibility.summary: This funding opportunity is a program supplement intended only for the 34 American Indian and Alaska Native (AI/AN) Tribes and regional AI/AN tribally designated organizations awarded funding under CDC-RFA-TO-23-0001: Strengthening Public Health Systems and Services in Indian Country. The CDC-RFA-TO-23-0001 recipients are eligible to submit applica In North Carolina, eligible entities fitting the organizational requirements may apply.

cost_share.details: No cost sharing or non-federal matching funds are required.

review_criteria.criterion: Work Plan Feasibility and Milestone Schedule

submission_limits: Applicant organizations may submit more than one proposal, provided each proposal is scientifically distinct.
important_notes: Opportunity Number: CDC-RFA-TO-23-00010101SUPP27 — Agency: CENTERS FOR DISEASE CONTROL  CSTLTS.
Forecasted Opportunity: This is an advance forecast notice. Official application packages and final closing dates will be released upon posting.
Application submission is administered via Grants.gov or the designated federal portal for opportunity CDC-RFA-TO-23-00010101SUPP27.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Review all instructions, eligibility requirements, and deadlines published on Grants.gov before preparing submission.
